title: Data Engineer
jobDescription:

- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Type of Contract: Permanent
- Grade: Band 2
- Type of work: Hybrid
- Work Language: Fluent Business English The

ROLE:
As a Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining highly scalable data management systems that enable Nespresso’s data-driven decision-making. You will integrate diverse data sources into a unified platform, ensuring data accessibility, reliability, and compliance with security standards. This role requires strong collaboration with data architects, modelers, and cross-functional teams to deliver robust data solutions that support advanced analytics, personalization, and marketing automation across global markets. In This Role, You Will:
- Design, construct, install, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines and management systems.
- Develop and optimize data pipelines using modern orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, ADF).
- Develop and maintain data warehouse transformations using dbt and modern data warehousing techniques such as dimensional modeling, incremental processing.
- Collaborate with data architects and IT teams to translate complex requirements into detailed designs.
- Ensure compliance with internal security and regulatory standards across all data processes.
- Integrate new data management technologies and software engineering tools into existing structures.
- Create custom software components and analytics applications to support business intelligence needs.
- Monitor pipeline stability and performance, implementing remediation plans when necessary.
- Provide data-access tools and visualization capabilities for non-technical users. What We’re Looking For:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.
- 4+ years of experience in data engineering or data-intensive development roles.
- Expertise in SQL, Python, and experience with CI/CD processes and Git.
- Strong knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and data integration techniques.
- Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, and containerized solutions (Docker).
- Hands-on experience with orchestration tools like Apache Airflow and dbt.
- Solid understanding of data science concepts, ML frameworks, and big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark).
- Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver projects within deadlines. Extra Skills That Set You Apart:
- Experience with streaming data processes and real-time analytics (Kafka, Flink).
- Focus on performance optimization, cost monitoring.
- Experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) and data visualization.
- Familiarity with marketing, e Commerce, and media data sources and their use cases. We Offer You: We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
- Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
- Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
- Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
- International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
- The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands. The Hiring Process:
- Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).

jobDescription:
Location: Moga, Punjab Experience: 4-6 Years Fixed Term Contract | 1 Year About the Role We are looking for a dynamic and execution-focused professional to support the adoption, stabilization, and governance of a critical digital application used across milk collection operations. This role will act as the key coordinator between business users, technology teams, vendors, and field operations to ensure seamless application deployment, user adoption, and project execution. - Dairy or milk procurement operations
- Agriculture or rural field operations
- FMCG or supply chain environments
- Mobile applications and digital transformation initiatives
- Vendor and field team management Contract Duration: 1 Year (Fixed Term Contract) Location: Moga, Punjab

title: Senior Nutrition Executive
jobDescription: Job Title: Nutrition Officer/ Executive Function: Infant Nutrition Location: Rajasthan About the role This is a field role focused on ethical engagement with Health Care Professionals (HCPs) to share scientific, evidence‑based information on infant nutrition and Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition portfolio. The role requires clear and compliant communication of product features, advantages and benefits, and their appropriate use—strictly within Nestlé’s Code of Ethics, company instructions, and the Indian Code. The role consistently upholds the principle that mother’s milk is best for babies. Job Description (Key Responsibilities) • Ethically promote Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition products to HCPs by clearly communicating product features, advantages, benefits and appropriate use, in line with company Code of Ethics and the Indian Code; reinforce that mother’s milk is best for babies. • Ensure recommendations for the Nestlé Nutrition product range remain within the scope of the Indian Code; detail against homemade paps and bovine milk as appropriate. • Serve as a reliable source of information on infant nutrition and infant feeding practices for HCPs. • Plan and execute high‑quality scientific detailing, CMEs/symposiums and other scientific activities as per company guidelines. • Map and segment HCPs in the assigned territory; develop and execute an effective coverage plan and call cycle. • Maintain accurate records of HCP interactions, feedback, and scientific events; provide timely reports as per guidance. • Identify opportunities and potential within the territory and contribute inputs to drive demand generation activities within compliance. • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure availability of compliant scientific materials and support tools for field execution. Qualifications • Graduate with at least 1 year of experience in a field sales role in either a Nutrition company or the pharmaceutical industry. • High level of integrity and honesty; hardworking, self‑motivated, and passionate about enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. • Ability to work effectively in a team and build strong, sustainable relationships with stakeholders. • High learning agility; trustworthy and able to work independently within company policies and guidelines. - Type of Contract: Permanent
- Function and Stream: IT – Marketing, Sales and e Business / Consumer Engagement Services
- Type of work: Hybrid
- Work Language: Fluent Business English The

The Zone Business Analyst acts as the primary interface between markets and the global CES team, ensuring business needs are captured, prioritized, translated into clear requirements, and delivered through scalable solutions. The role combines business analysis, project delivery, governance, and adoption leadership, with a strong focus on Salesforce Service Cloud / Engage OMNI as the core platform. - Gather, analyze, prioritize, and refine market requirements for Engage OMNI and related CES capabilities, ensuring they are ready for technical assessment and delivery.
- Lead zone governance routines, including regular market calls, monthly updates, escalation reviews, and communication of product enhancements.
- Support product rollouts in the zone, including global integrations such as Whats App, Magento, CIAM, messaging channels, and future CES capabilities.
- Collaborate with product owners, solution architects, and technical teams to assess feasibility, estimate effort, and align on delivery approach.
- Create and maintain functional documentation, knowledge articles, training materials, and end-user guidance to support adoption and change management.
- Track market requests and follow up on open items to ensure progress, visibility, and timely resolution across the zone. We offer you: We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
- Great benefits including salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the best pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc .
- Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
- Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!
- Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities. Join our global team of IT professionals at Nestlé, driving daily innovation and leveraging cutting-edge technologies to address digital opportunities. Grow professionally in a dynamic and impactful environment, collaborating with business partners worldwide to deliver integrated technology solutions! What will make you a great fit? We are looking for someone who brings:
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, business administration, computer science, digital technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in IT or digital transformation environments.
- Experience gathering, documenting, prioritizing, and refining business requirements with multiple stakeholders.
- Good understanding of Salesforce Service Cloud or CRM / customer engagement platforms, ideally in a global or multi-market context.
- Salesforce System Admin certification.
- Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to engage business and IT stakeholders at different levels of the organization. Bonus Points If You:
- Are familiar with Agile ways of working, backlog refinement, RICE prioritization, Jira, or similar delivery practices.
- Have experience supporting global rollouts, change management, user training, or documentation for digital products. Not a 100% match? No worries! Nestlé supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. What you can expect in your application journey:
1. Hit apply and enter our job portal.
2. Submit your application with your CV.
3. We will contact relevant applicants.
4. Interviews (HR, Hiring team and stakeholders).
5. Feedback.
6. We make an offer.
7. Location dependent checks and pre-onboarding.
